oil.when: 2016 S-Class Coupe with the ASSYST PLUS service display
steps: Have the oil, filter and scheduled service done first; the reminder is tied to the service actually being carried out.
The 2016 S-Class Coupe owner's manual gives no driver reset. It says the workshop that does the service resets the ASSYST PLUS service display afterward.

To see when the next service is due: switch the ignition on, open the menu list with the steering wheel button, choose Service and press OK, then choose ASSYST PLUS and press OK. The due date shows in the cluster display.

notes: Only the 2016 S-Class Coupe manual was checked. It says the workshop resets the ASSYST PLUS service reminder after the service. The tire pressure restart was not verified for this model.
